claims.content: Business Owner
The system must have recorded customer purchase transaction data (sales data) available to generate the analysis report.
The user must have access to the Auction Administration section where the RFM report is located.
The Business Owner selects a timeframe (Lifetime or Past 12 Months) and clicks the 'Go' button to generate the RFM report.

trigger.raw_text: The Business Owner selects a timeframe (Lifetime or Past 12 Months) and clicks the 'Go' button to generate the RFM report.

claims.content: The Business Owner navigates to the 'Auction Customer RFM Report' page within the Auction Administration section.
The Business Owner selects the desired timeframe for the report by choosing either the 'Run Lifetime Report' or 'Run Past 12 Months Report' radio button.
The Business Owner clicks the 'Go' button to generate the report.
The system displays the RFM analysis report, segmented into Monetary, Recency, and Frequency sections, showing accounts, revenue, orders, and calculated metrics per tier.
The system displays the RFM analysis report segmented into Recency, Monetary, and Frequency sections.
The Recency section displays data split into six tiers: 0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 181-365 days, and over 365 days.
The report shows the total number of accounts, revenue, and order amounts for each tier.
Calculated fields including revenue per account, orders per account, and percentage of total accounts within each tier are displayed.
A final row displaying the total for each column is included in the report sections.
